from_quote: Within every successive term of ten years a census of inhabitants is to be repeated. The unequivocal objects of these regulations are, first, to readjust, from time to time, the apportionment of representatives to the number of inhabitants, under the single exception that each State shall have one representative at least; secondly, to augment the number of representatives at the same periods, under the sole limitation that the whole number shall not exceed one for every thirty thousand inhabitants.
rationale: Sets out the regulations of this clause on the number of representatives: the first number for three years, a census every ten years, "one representative at least" for each State, and the words "shall not exceed one for every thirty thousand."
to_quote: The Number of Representatives shall not exceed one for every thirty Thousand, but each State shall have at Least one Representative

from_quote: the equal authority which will subsist between the two houses on all legislative subjects, except the originating of money bills
rationale: Names "the originating of money bills" as the one exception to the equal authority of the two houses, echoing this clause's "shall originate."
to_quote: All Bills for raising Revenue shall originate in the House of Representatives

from_quote: the number made competent for legislative business. It has been said that more than a majority ought to have been required for a quorum
rationale: Takes up the objection to "the number made competent for legislative business," a majority "for a quorum," pointing at this clause's words "a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business."
to_quote: a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business
